description: In many cases 可以表示『很多時候』『很多情況下』『大量個案中』『很多不同類型的案例中』。 因此替換前要先判斷句子強調的是 frequency, situations, individual instances, case count, prevalence, breadth of contexts, or majority tendency。

words.example: In many cases, early treatment improves recovery; often, early treatment improves recovery.
words.exampleZh: 很多情況下，及早治療有助改善康復。

exercises.original: In many cases, a brief explanation is enough.

options.explanation: Often ✓ — frequently; on many occasions。原句只說「簡短說明在很多情況下已足夠」。Often 可自然作句首頻率副詞；Frequently 也可，原句沒有數字可把兩者分成唯一對錯。
Frequently — often; many times or on many occasions。frequently 聚焦頻率；如果句子要保留『多個個案／情境』的框架，會少一層 case-based 意味。
Usually — in most cases or on most occasions。usually 往往暗示『大多數情況』，強度通常比 in many cases 更高。
Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示毫無例外，明顯太強。
Sometimes — on some occasions but not often。sometimes 只表示有時，通常比 in many cases 弱很多。
Generally — in most respects or as a broad generalisation。generally 是整體概括，不一定表示有很多個具體案例。

options.explanation: In a wide range of cases ✓ — across many different kinds of cases。both simple and complex disputes 明確列出兩類不同爭議；In a wide range of cases 強調適用範圍廣，而非只計個案數。
In many situations — across a large number of situations or circumstances。這個表達強調不同情況，不等於統計或個案數量很多。
Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示毫無例外，明顯太強。
Sometimes — on some occasions but not often。sometimes 只表示有時，通常比 in many cases 弱很多。
Usually — in most cases or on most occasions。usually 往往暗示『大多數情況』，強度通常比 in many cases 更高。

exercises.original: In many cases, the same design principle works for homes, offices and public spaces.
exercises.zh: 同一設計原則適用於住宅、辦公室和公共空間等廣泛情況。
exercises.upgrade: The same design principle works in a wide range of cases, including homes, offices and public spaces.
exercises.answer: In a wide range of cases

options.text: In a wide range of cases
options.explanation: In a wide range of cases ✓ — across many different kinds of cases。homes, offices and public spaces 列出不同使用場景；In a wide range of cases 概括這種跨場景的適用性。
Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示毫無例外，明顯太強。
Sometimes — on some occasions but not often。sometimes 只表示有時，通常比 in many cases 弱很多。
Usually — in most cases or on most occasions。usually 往往暗示『大多數情況』，強度通常比 in many cases 更高。

words.example: More often than not, a short explanation is enough.
words.exampleZh: 多數時候，簡短解釋已經足夠。

exercises.original: In many cases (about 70% in this survey), a short conversation solves the problem.
exercises.zh: 在這項調查中，約七成情況下，一次簡短對話便能解決問題。
exercises.upgrade: More often than not, a short conversation solves the problem (about 70% in this survey).

options.explanation: Usually — in most cases or on most occasions。usually 往往暗示『大多數情況』，強度通常比 in many cases 更高。
Often — frequently; on many occasions。often 是自然廣義替代，但若題目明確強調 formal instances、case count、breadth of case types 或 majority，另有更精準詞。
Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示毫無例外，明顯太強。
More often than not ✓ — in most cases or on most occasions。這道改寫題另給了約七成的調查結果，明確超過一半；more often than not 表示「多數時候」。單獨的 in many cases 並不保證過半。
Sometimes — on some occasions but not often。sometimes 只表示有時，通常比 in many cases 弱很多。
Generally — in most respects or as a broad generalisation。generally 是整體概括，不一定表示有很多個具體案例。

exercises.original: In many cases (about 60% in these observations), the simplest answer is the correct one.
exercises.zh: 在這些觀察中，約六成情況下，最簡單的答案就是正確答案。
exercises.upgrade: More often than not, the simplest answer is the correct one (about 60% in these observations).

options.explanation: Usually — in most cases or on most occasions。usually 往往暗示『大多數情況』，強度通常比 in many cases 更高。
Often — frequently; on many occasions。often 是自然廣義替代，但若題目明確強調 formal instances、case count、breadth of case types 或 majority，另有更精準詞。
Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示毫無例外，明顯太強。
Sometimes — on some occasions but not often。sometimes 只表示有時，通常比 in many cases 弱很多。
More often than not ✓ — in most cases or on most occasions。題目另外指出約六成的觀察結果，才足以支持 more often than not 的「過半」意思；原來的 in many cases 本身沒有這個保證。
Generally — in most respects or as a broad generalisation。generally 是整體概括，不一定表示有很多個具體案例。

exercises.original: In many cases (about two-thirds of the survey responses), people choose convenience over cost.
exercises.zh: 在這項調查中，約三分之二的人會選擇方便而不是低成本。
exercises.upgrade: More often than not, people choose convenience over cost (about two-thirds of the survey responses).

options.explanation: Usually — in most cases or on most occasions。usually 往往暗示『大多數情況』，強度通常比 in many cases 更高。
Often — frequently; on many occasions。often 是自然廣義替代，但若題目明確強調 formal instances、case count、breadth of case types 或 majority，另有更精準詞。
Always — on every occasion without exception。always 表示毫無例外，明顯太強。
Sometimes — on some occasions but not often。sometimes 只表示有時，通常比 in many cases 弱很多。
Generally — in most respects or as a broad generalisation。generally 是整體概括，不一定表示有很多個具體案例。
More often than not ✓ — in most cases or on most occasions。題目提供了約三分之二的調查比例，明確是多數；因此可用 more often than not。若沒有這個比例，in many cases 不一定等於「多數」。

falseSynonyms.zh: 總是 ≠ in many cases always 表示所有情況，強度過高。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Always means without exception.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通常 ≠ in many cases usually 常暗示大多數情況；in many cases 不一定達到『通常』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Usually is stronger in frequency.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有時 ≠ in many cases sometimes 通常比 in many cases 弱得多。
一般而言 ≠ in many cases generally 是整體概括，不一定指多個具體案例。
只在頻率 sense 接近 frequently 不保留『多個案例』的框架。
只在普遍性 sense 接近 commonly 偏 widespread/usual，而不是單純 case count。
多數情況 ≠ in many cases in most cases 強度更高，明確表示 majority。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Most is stronger than many.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數與詞義陷阱 case 可指情況、個案、案件；要按語境理解。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Check countability and sense.
